state.name: ANTHROPIC_API_KEY
state.why: read from apikey.txt / env at boot

state.name: priceCache
state.why: refilled by the price poll within a minute

state.name: signalCache
state.why: rebuilt by the next refreshSignals cycle

state.name: signalHistory
state.why: DISPLAY buffer only, 100 cycles. The durable record is the SQLite signals table via persistSignalChanges(), and its own comment says a restart writing one row per asset is wanted

state.name: mt5CandleCache
state.why: refilled by the next bridge bar push

state.name: mt5SymbolSpecs
state.why: re-fetched from the bridge on demand

state.name: tvAlerts
state.why: display buffer in tv_alerts.json, plus an append-only archive in tasks/logs/tv_alerts.jsonl

state.name: congressCache
state.why: re-fetched from Unusual Whales on first request

state.name: flowCache
state.why: re-fetched from Unusual Whales on first request

state.name: knownChatIds
state.why: Telegram chat ids. TELEGRAM_CHAT_ID is re-seeded from keys.env at boot and any other chat re-registers on its next message

state.name: mt5PositionsByAccount
state.why: the bridge re-pushes positions within ~60s; the broker is the source of truth, not this

state.name: features
state.why: newsFilter can block a setup and trailingStop is read by the bridge — a toggle that reverts itself is worse than no toggle

state.name: riskStatus
state.why: the BRIDGE owns the breaker and persists it to breaker_state_<TAG>.json, then re-pushes; this copy is derived

state.name: strategySettings
state.why: read from strategy_settings.json at boot; the FILE is the state, this is the copy

state.name: lastUpdateId
state.why: Telegram long-poll cursor; restarting re-syncs it

state.name: manualTradeQueue
state.why: trades awaiting human approval — losing a pending DECISION is worse than losing a log line

state.name: mt5LastSeenByAccount
state.why: rebuilt by the next bridge check-in

state.name: riskStatusByAccount
state.why: same — bridge-owned and re-pushed per account

state.name: tradingControl
state.why: a halt is a safety decision and must outlive the process

state.name: lastNearMissMalformed
state.why: diagnostic counter for this process; the ledger file holds the data

state.name: _lastAnalysisFingerprint
state.why: dedupe key for the current process

state.name: backtestCache
state.why: recomputed on request; a 12h cache, not a record

state.name: aiFilterHealth
state.why: counters for the current process; the durable record is the rejection ledger

state.name: engineSetupNamesCache
state.why: derived from the engine source at first use

note: Every module-level binding in the server must be classified: persisted (verified, not claimed), regenerable (says from where), or accepted (a decision on record). Unclassified state is the finding. PROPOSES ONLY.
